definition: At cut i, Sigma_i(r) is the affine set r+R_i of all final low residuals reachable by remaining algebraic repair blocks; q_i identifies equality of these complete reachable-residual sets.

exact_theorem.coarsest: Any state descriptor recovering the complete affine reachable-residual set refines the coset quotient.
exact_theorem.descended_relational_transition: Because R_i=W_i+R_(i+1), the set of Q_(i+1) classes reachable from a Q_i class by W_i is representative-independent.
exact_theorem.final_factorization: FILTRATION_LIFT at cut i iff q_i(r)=0.
exact_theorem.signature_equality: Sigma_i(r)=Sigma_i(r') iff r-r' lies in R_i
